scope: Shared host native scheduling/field-prefix kernels with concrete BINARY and CPU adapters. No AIR, transcript, schema, wire or GPU backend change.

kernel_contracts.physical_fill: Comptime Adapter.Context/BINS and range-row formatter; private per-worker histograms, physical16-row partitions, allocation/submission startgate, cancellation/drain, checked ordered histogram merge, success-only histogram publication.
kernel_contracts.prefix: Comptime carry-count and typed job adapter; one existing WorkLease, two fresh joined WaitGroups with completeWave, logical ordered summary scan, per-component ledger check, then physical-range correction.
kernel_contracts.numerical_authority: Existing row formatters remain unchanged. BINARY serial and pooled interactions invoke one factored numerical chunk writer. CPU chunk arithmetic and physical correction remain unchanged.
kernel_contracts.resource_ownership: Caller owns provisional MAIN/INTER, metadata, per-worker heap scratch and immutable inputs; no nested pool/global scratch. INTER publishes and metadata retires only after both waves complete successfully.

gates.proof_bytes: Actual joined q70 proof bytes and physical claims EXACT at1/3/16workers versus serial, with independently constructed fresh receivers. Indexed scalar/Packed16/pooled proof bytes EXACT.
gates.matrix_claims: Every MAIN/metadata/histogram/INTER/claim compared; CPU raw44/raw46/index40 controls at1/4/16workers, weightedBINARY at1/3/16; source MAIN released before challenged pooled generation.
gates.errors: Nondivisible physical ranges, partial chunks, physical prefix/halo mappings, checked histogram overflow and aliasing, OOM, both-wave0/1helper submission failures, callback failure/drain/pool reuse, strict late zero-weight padding pole and late histogram mismatch/retry.

limits: No performance improvement is claimed from kernel extraction.
ALU/SHIFT/LS/boundary adapters intentionally unchanged in this slice.
Generic callbacks are total prevalidated row formatters, not VM execution; no replay or extra wide witness.
Pre-start submission/alloc failures preserve borrowed row output. Post-join histogram rejection can modify provisional row output; caller must discard it. No general rollback claim.
Accepting proof/transcript paths remain canonical; no new profile enum or machine factory.
Standalone historical artifact regeneration is separate from in-memory exact-byte proof gates.
